about: Attorney Edward I. Golden is a founding partner of the Miami law firm of Golden Glasko Haddy and Associates, P.A. Since founding the firm, Mr. Golden has focused his practice on estate-related litigation and appeals. Thanks to his long record of success and reputation as a dedicated client advocate, clients from throughout South Florida know to turn to him for assistance with matters related to the following:

Mr. Golden began his legal career in 1977 after earning his law degree from the University of Miami School of Law and his admission to The Florida Bar. In addition to his approval to practice law in all of Florida's state courts, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit have also issued their approvals for him to practice in their courtrooms.

Over the course of Mr. Golden's nearly 40-year legal career, he has earned the respect of both his clients and his peers, earning him a number of honors and awards. He has received an AV Preeminent peer review rating* from Martindale-Hubbell, and The Wall Street Journal has included him on its list of the top Florida attorneys.

Attorney Golden is a valued member of the legal community and one of its recognized leaders. In addition to his membership in The Florida Bar, where he serves on a number of committees, he is a member of the Dade County Bar Association, where he served as director, and the American Bar Association.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
